problems.problem: BRICS does not have a headquarters; the New Development Bank is in Shanghai but that is not the BRICS secretariat.
problems.verifierReason: BRICS has no HQ; NDB in Shanghai is separate. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: Countries such as Denmark and Sweden retain opt‑outs despite meeting criteria.
problems.problem: Sweden does not have a formal opt‑out from the euro; it is legally obliged to adopt the euro once it meets the convergence criteria, though it has avoided joining ERM II.
problems.correction: Denmark retains an opt‑out; Sweden is obliged to adopt the euro once it meets the criteria but has not joined ERM II.
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly states Sweden has an opt-out; correction accurately describes Denmark's opt-out and Sweden's obligation without ERM II.

problems.quote: World Environment Day (5 June) originates from Resolution 2994 (XXVII) of 1972, which also created the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
problems.problem: Resolution 2994 (XXVII) established World Environment Day; UNEP was created by a separate resolution, 2997 (XXVII).
problems.correction: World Environment Day (5 June) originates from Resolution 2994 (XXVII) of 1972; UNEP was created by Resolution 2997 (XXVII).
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly attributes UNEP creation to Resolution 2994; correction correctly cites Resolution 2997 for UNEP.
